description: This PHP source file defines a class AdministrationViewThemeConfigSettings that manages the display and processing of theme configuration settings in the SuiteCRM administration interface. It handles user authorization, theme validation, saving configuration changes, and rendering the theme settings form.

classes.name: AdministrationViewThemeConfigSettings
classes.description: A view class for displaying and saving theme configuration settings in the SuiteCRM admin panel.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Generates the title parameters for the module, including a link to the module's main page and the theme settings label.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles user request to save theme configuration or display the theme settings form, ensuring proper authorization and theme validation.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the theme configuration settings form with current theme settings.
